pr_title: [BugFix][SFA] Guard DSA-CP graph padding sequence lengths
source_quote:
![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)
> ### Efficiency Optimization
> Using `torch.zeros_like(seq_lens)` allocates a new tensor of zeros on the NPU device. Since `torch.where` supports a scalar `0` as the fallback value, we can pass `0` directly to avoid this allocation.
> Additionally, the condition `(num_local_tokens > 0) & (seq_lens > 0)` performs an extra element-wise logical AND operation on the NPU. Since `torch.clamp_min(seq_lens - offset, 0)` naturally clamps any negative values (including when `seq_lens` is `0` and `offset >= 0`) to `0`, the `seq_lens > 0` check is redundant.
> We can simplify this to a single `torch.where` call with `num_local_tokens > 0` and a scalar `0` fallback, which is mathematically identical, more readable, and more efficient for the hot-path execution.
> ```python
local_key_lens = torch.where(
num_local_tokens > 0,
torch.clamp_min(seq_lens - offset, 0),
0,
)

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha cd73c53 体现修改

rule.description: 在每步推理都会执行的热路径（如 attention metadata builder）中，`torch.where(cond, x, fallback)` 的 `fallback` 应优先使用标量 `0` 而非 `torch.zeros_like(...)`，避免在 NPU/GPU 上分配临时 tensor 和启动 zero-fill kernel。同时，若 `x` 已通过 `torch.clamp_min(..., 0)` 将非正值 clamp 到 0，则条件中无需再叠加 `seq_lens > 0` 这类被 clamp 覆盖的子条件，避免额外的逐元素 AND 运算。
checkpoints: 检查热路径（metadata builder、forward、scheduler 等每步执行函数）中的 `torch.where(..., torch.zeros_like(t))` 模式，是否可改为标量 `0`
检查 `torch.where` 的条件是否为 `(A > 0) & (B > 0)` 形式，且其中 `B > 0` 是否已被第二参数的 `torch.clamp_min(B - offset, 0)` 覆盖
确认标量 `0` 的类型转换安全：`torch.where` 会按第二参数 dtype 自动 cast 标量
检查是否在不必要的位置创建中间变量（如 `valid_local_req = ...`）增加一次 kernel launch

antipattern.code:
class SFAV1DSA-CPMetadataBuilder:
    """DSA-CP metadata builder — 每步推理都执行的热路径"""

    def build(self, seq_lens, num_local_tokens, ...):
        # ... 前置计算 ...
        global_end = self._compute_global_end(seq_lens)
        req_local_end = self._compute_req_local_end(num_local_tokens)

        local_query_lens = torch.cumsum(num_local_tokens.clamp(min=0), dim=0)
        offset = global_end - req_local_end  # request tokens on later ranks

        # 额外的逐元素 AND 运算
        valid_local_req = (num_local_tokens > 0) & (seq_lens > 0)
        local_key_lens = torch.where(
            valid_local_req,
            torch.clamp_min(seq_lens - offset, 0),
            torch.zeros_like(seq_lens),   # 在 NPU 上分配新 tensor + 启动 zero-fill kernel
        )

        # ... 后续 metadata 构建 ...

        local_query_lens = torch.cumsum(num_local_tokens.clamp(min=0), dim=0)
        offset = global_end - req_local_end  # request tokens on later ranks

        # 删除冗余的 valid_local_req 行：clamp_min 已处理 seq_lens<=0 的情形

            num_local_tokens > 0,
            torch.clamp_min(seq_lens - offset, 0),
            0,   # 标量 0，torch.where 会自动按第二参数 dtype 做类型转换
        )

        # ... 后续 metadata 构建 ...
